claim_boundary: This artifact compiles high-multiplicity collision rays into an exact valuation-labelled Freiman web. It proves no low-multiplicity bound, seed realization, simple-root closure, complete moment, density, or intervals.

freiman_ray_web_theorem.boundary: no low-multiplicity collision bound, seed realization, simple-root closure, complete moment, density, or prime intervals is proved
freiman_ray_web_theorem.collision_web: for each occupied a, Cycle 92 supplies one injective reduced label r_a=p_a/q_a with |r_a-g^a|<<1/(KQ) and q_a<<Q/M
freiman_ray_web_theorem.energy: for R occupied modes in an interval of D consecutive integers, E_plus(A)>=R^4/(2D-1); every one of these quadruples is an exact multiplicative-label quadruple in the high-multiplicity range
freiman_ray_web_theorem.integer_forcing: a nonzero rational product difference is >>M^4/Q^4; therefore M^4K>>Q^3 forces r_a1 r_a2=r_a3 r_a4
freiman_ray_web_theorem.seed_gate: energy alone does not give an anchored transport seed; E16 still requires a popular-difference/codegree extraction and a phase-error budget tied to the original packet anchor
freiman_ray_web_theorem.threshold: with M=X^mu and K=X^xi, the high-multiplicity condition is mu>(1-xi)/4; otherwise mu<=(1-xi)/4 up to the frozen constant buffer
freiman_ray_web_theorem.valuation_web: for every prime p and additive quadruple, nu_p(r_a1)+nu_p(r_a2)=nu_p(r_a3)+nu_p(r_a4); the full valuation vector is a Freiman 2-homomorphism on the occupied mode set

lower_endpoint_threshold.condition: strictly greater, with frozen constant buffer

remaining_target.statement: control the complementary low-multiplicity rays or extract a popular-difference anchored seed from the Freiman web
